name: ClipRRect
description: A widget that clips its child with a rounded rectangle. Useful for creating rounded corners for images, containers, or any rectangular widget.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to display inside the rounded rectangle clip.

properties.name: borderRadius
properties.description: The radius of the rounded corners.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the content if it overflows the rounded rectangle boundary.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.
